summary: 8 browser checks executed for the 7 acceptance criteria of the Caliber 08 procedural watch experience (standalone Vite/Three.js frontend, no backend API per spec_deviations). All checks passed.

checks.criterion: The public Caliber 08 experience loads and presents the procedural watch hero with persistent section navigation
checks.name: hero-loads-with-nav-and-scene
checks.evidence: Hero rendered with Caliber 08 title, watch mesh, and visible Explore/Index/Finishes nav links; body text contained '57' mesh reference. Screenshot confirms rendered 3D watch hero.

checks.criterion: The public Caliber 08 experience loads and presents the procedural watch hero with persistent section navigation
checks.name: scene-reports-57-meshes-and-parts
checks.evidence: After scrolling into the Assembly beat, body text contained 'NO MODEL NO TEXTURES NO ASSETS 57 MESHES' and 'Component types 14 Meshes 57', confirming the live scene reports 57 meshes / 14 component types (57 parts).

checks.criterion: The scroll-led editorial experience remains usable after the visual enhancement
checks.name: scroll-track-changes-beat-content
checks.evidence: Captured body text + screenshots at 3 scroll depths; text differed between each depth (Overview -> Case/Bezel -> Assembly beats), zero pageerror events and zero failed network requests recorded.

checks.criterion: The component index is an architectural card grid with useful filtering
checks.name: index-movement-filter-shows-two
checks.evidence: Navigated to Index section, clicked Movement filter button; body text contained 'Showing 2 Movement component types', 'Mainplate', and 'Rotor'.

checks.criterion: The finale clearly supports finish comparison
checks.name: finale-next-finish-changes-to-graphite
checks.evidence: Finale showed 'Brushed steel' + '01 / 04' initially; after clicking 'Next finish' body text updated to contain 'Graphite' and '02 / 04'.

checks.criterion: The custom finale cursor does not obscure real controls
checks.name: finale-cursor-does-not-obscure-controls
checks.evidence: Hovered the Graphite finish option button, screenshot shows clean unobstructed UI (no decorative cursor overlay covering controls); click succeeded and body text updated to 'Graphite'.

checks.criterion: Reduced-motion users receive a readable fallback
checks.name: reduced-motion-shows-readable-fallback
checks.evidence: With page.emulateMedia({reducedMotion:'reduce'}) set before navigation, screenshot shows a stacked static document (Caliber 08 title, '00 - Overview / Nothing here was loaded', '01 - Case / Brushed and beveled' sections) with no pinned WebGL choreography; body text contained 'Mainplate'.

checks.name: keyboard-controls-are-focusable
checks.evidence: Explore/Index/Finishes nav links, Movement index filter button, and Next finish button were each .focus()-able and toBeFocused()-verified; Enter key activation on Index nav link navigated section, on Movement filter produced 'Showing 2 Movement component types', and on Next finish button produced 'Graphite' in body text.

notes: No backend API exists in this repo (standalone Vite/Three.js frontend per spec_deviations); no backend pytest lane was applicable and none was written.

Acceptance matrix had 7 criteria; 8 browser checks were used because the first criterion (hero load + persistent nav + scene mesh/part counts) was split into two focused checks (hero render/nav, and the 57-meshes/parts reporting on scroll) for clearer, single-flow evidence.
Public ingress URL https://blog-552.preview.emergentagent.com was used for all checks as instructed by spec_deviations.
